image_description: A retail display rack filled with various comic books and graphic novels. The rack is white wire-frame, holding multiple rows of periodicals. Visible titles include 'The Walking Dead', 'Spawn', 'X-Men', and 'Superman'. The comics are arranged vertically and horizontally, showing glossy covers with colorful illustrations and bold typography. A black chair is visible to the right, and other merchandise hangs in the background.
